flufenamic acid.translation: [化] 氟芬那酸; 氟灭酸

fluff.definition:
n. any light downy material
n. a blunder (especially an actor's forgetting the lines)
fluff.translation:
n. 软毛, 柔毛, 绒毛, 错误, 无价值的东西
vi. 起毛, 变松, 出错
vt. 使起毛, 抖松, 念错

fluffed.definition:
v make a mess of, destroy or ruin
v erect or fluff up
v ruffle (one's hair) by combing the ends towards the scalp, for a full effect
fluffed.translation: v. （使）起毛, （使）变松( fluff的过去式和过去分词 ); 抖松; 刷柔软（羽毛、毛皮、毛发等）

fluffhead.translation: n. <美俚>轻佻女子,没头脑的女人,傻丫头

fluffier.definition: s. like down or as soft as down
fluffier.translation: a. 似绒毛的( fluffy的比较级 ); 有绒毛的; 蓬松的; 轻软状的

fluffies.definition:
plural of fluffy
s like down or as soft as down
fluffies.translation:
(fluffy 的复数) a. 毛绒绒的, 蓬松的, 空洞的, 无内容的, 不明确的
[医] 绒毛状的

fluffiest.definition: s. like down or as soft as down
fluffiest.translation: a. 似绒毛的( fluffy的最高级 ); 有绒毛的; 蓬松的; 轻软状的

fluffing.definition:
v make a mess of, destroy or ruin

v. （使）起毛, （使）变松( fluff的第三人称单数 ); 抖松; 刷柔软（羽毛、毛皮、毛发等）
